messages.subject: Controlling Gridlines in a plot
parts:
Hi,

Suppose I have following plot :

library(zoo)
dat <- zooreg(rnorm(13), start=as.yearmon("2009-01-01"), frequency=12)
dat1 <- data.frame(index(dat), coredata(dat))

ggplot(dat1) +
geom_line(aes(y = dat1[,2], x = dat1[,1]))

However I want to do following with this plot
1. want to change format of dates for x-axis. I want to plut labels in
format "Jan-09", "Feb-09" etc
2. I want to get control of the major and minor gridlines. For
example, I want there will only be 3 major gridlines in places "="Jan
2009", "Apr 2009", "Jul 2009" and there will not be any minor
gridlines.

Can anyone please help me how to do that? I tried with scale_x_date(),
however it is not helping.

Thanks,

messages.author: 7e54aa65e5af5819
messages.subject: Re: Controlling Gridlines in a plot
parts:
ggplot2 doesn't support zoo objects, so you need to convert these into
dates either in the data frame or in the ggplot2 aes-call. After that
you can use scale_x_date() to modify minor and major gridlines and
label formatting.

dat1 <- data.frame(index = index(dat), coredata = coredata(dat))

ggplot(dat1) + geom_line(aes(as.Date(index), coredata))

last_plot() + scale_x_date(major="3 months", minor = "3 months",
format="%b-%Y")

--
http://learnr.wordpress.com

> last_plot() + scale_x_date(limits = c(as.Date(dat1[1,1]), as.Date(dat1
> [13,1])), major="3 months", minor = "3 months",  format="%b-%Y")
>
>
> However still there are blank spaces at the both edges. i.e. that line-
> plot does not start from the left edge and stop at the right edge. I
> also tried with coord_cartesian(), however it is not working in
> present case. It seems that it does not work with date-class. Can
> anyone please help me how to do that?

First of all, I'd strongly discourage you from doing that, those gaps
have an important perceptual purpose: separating the data from the
axes. If you remove them you are at substantial risk of confusing the
two.

If you really want to do it, you can do it with this hack:

ggplot(dat1) + geom_line(aes(as.Date(index), coredata))

dt <- scale_x_date(major="3 months", minor = "3 months", format="%b-%Y")
dt$.expand <- c(0, 0)

last_plot() + dt
